newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Fire in Swiss capital leaves one missing.
newsitem.headline: Fire in Swiss capital leaves one missing.

text.p: Fire swept through a historic district of the Swiss capital Berne on Thursday, leaving one person missing and believed dead, Swiss radio reported.
Two people were taken to the hospital suffering from smoke inhalation.
The fire took hold in six houses in the historic old quarter of the city. It began in the early hours in one of the houses and spread to the other five.
Around 200 firefighters were at the scene of the fire, which was being brought under control.
